sql: SELECT timestamp,source,log_attributes['request_id'] AS request_id,log_attributes['operation'] AS operation,splitByChar('?',log_attributes['req.url'])[1] AS object_route,log_attributes['res.statusCode'] AS status,log_attributes['responseTime'] AS response_ms FROM logs WHERE source='storage_logs' AND log_attributes['request_id'] IN ('01a19d18-f7ab-7082-9de2-c32bbf2ad598','01a19d1a-138f-7d2f-b8a7-a1fee8097527') ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 5
